speech_verification.heard: You might think a tsunami destroys everything it touches. In 1868, a massive earthquake leveled the port of Erika, Peru. While other ships were crushed, the USS Watery had a flat bottom. The 50-foot wave carried the gunboat inland without tipping it over. It sat perfectly upright, 500 yards into the desert. The Navy ship spent its final years serving as a desert inn.
